verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants work with error, performance, and log data. Its docs give a concrete connection command (`claude mcp add --transport http glitchtip https://<instance>/mcp`) and list tools such as browsing and inspecting issues, `update_issue`, `list_logs`, and `detect_n_plus_one`. A probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in real use.
